content_md: Reading Chapter 3 of Revolutionary Spring on the July revolution against Charles 10 in 1830. First proper revolt against a monarch trying to ride roughshod over a modern constitution. Impressive episode. Gaining a new respect for French political innovation. The US seems unable to conjure up a similar defense of constitutional authority nearly 200 years later.
